<subject>Re: Company Secretary Replacement</subject>
<body>
We will miss you too. Glad you stayed on as long as you did. See you at the Board meeting.

Elliot
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Bailey, Ann
Sent: Thursday, 7 November 2024 19:25
To: Cole, Elliot; Russell, Kirsty
Subject: Company Secretary Replacement

As you probably know, I will officially retire on 31 December 2024; so the meeting on 11 November will be my last and a good time to appoint my successor. Thanks for letting me continue as your company secretary after stepping down from that role at Halcyon Mutual Bank. I don't think I could have stopped "cold turkey," and I loved Halcyon because of my fondness for the board members and most of the senior management. (I’ll reserve comments on some who are no longer here.) I have really enjoyed the role since Hugh-the-Man got involved, and the improved morale and financial results show how positive that was for the bank. I have also long admired Sterling Trust and enjoyed working with Oliver Leonard. So, it is my hope and sincere recommendation that Oliver be selected to succeed me. He has repeatedly shown he is capable of the role—in fact, he’s been doing most of the work for a long time, except taking the minutes, which he has taken over more than once. He’s a person of integrity, loyalty, and dedication, and I know the Board likes him. I hope you both agree. I’ll miss you all, and Valerie, I’d love to have lunch with you and Oliver anytime. I’m also available for any help or advice I can offer. Thanks again. Much love, Kathryn Archer
</quoted>
